amendment_scope.existing_r2_harness_and_tests: UNCHANGED / NOT AUTHORIZED TO MODIFY IN THIS CHECKPOINT

r2_accepted_case_state_reference.frozen_input_rule: the 42-case multi-axis case state is a frozen input; this amendment derives no new case state and changes no axis value

FUNDAMENTAL_DOMAIN_RULE.order: WORKSTREAM_DOMAIN_ELIGIBLE in {YES, NO} must be mechanically determined per case and per workstream BEFORE any bucket projection
FUNDAMENTAL_DOMAIN_RULE.uniform_record_field_is_not_domain_evide: a PRODUCT_STATUS / MEASUREMENT_STATUS / CITATION_STATUS field existing in the case record is never by itself domain evidence
FUNDAMENTAL_DOMAIN_RULE.evidence_requirement: domain membership requires governed case-specific evidence; a schema default or an enum default value is not evidence
FUNDAMENTAL_DOMAIN_RULE.traceability_gate: every domain membership must carry a traceable governing source (path plus field_or_section) under the frozen hierarchy S1 > S2 > S3 > S4; a membership without a traceable source is not admissible

OUT_OF_WORKSTREAM_DOMAIN.case_visibility: the case remains in the 42-case inventory; only its membership in this particular workstream row is OUT_OF_WORKSTREAM_DOMAIN
OUT_OF_WORKSTREAM_DOMAIN.semantics: out-of-domain is a domain state, not a defect state and not a bucket; it asserts only that this workstream has no governed case-specific evidence for the case
OUT_OF_WORKSTREAM_DOMAIN.effect_on_other_workstreams: none; the same case may be domain eligible in a different workstream on independent governed evidence
OUT_OF_WORKSTREAM_DOMAIN.effect_on_case_state: none; no axis status, confidence, freshness or blocked-path field may be inferred from out-of-domain

PRODUCT_WORKSTREAM_DOMAIN.family_filter_source: Amendment 002 PRIMARY_ROOT_CAUSE_FILTER (WS-09 = HISTORY, WS-10 = RETRIEVAL, WS-11 = GENERATION)
PRODUCT_WORKSTREAM_DOMAIN.DOMAIN_ELIGIBLE_when: governed case-specific evidence associates the case with the workstream's corresponding Product root-cause family
admissible_domain_evidence: CURRENT product family evidence (current-state governed diagnosis carrying the family)
HISTORICAL_ONLY product family evidence (historical governed per-case attribution carrying the family)
RESOLVED historical linkage (a governed later remediation record that traceably associates the case with the family)
explicit governed diagnostic scope (the case is explicitly inside a governed diagnostic target scope for that family)
PRODUCT_WORKSTREAM_DOMAIN.rule: PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILY_PRESENT may establish domain eligibility; PRODUCT_STATUS and ATTRIBUTION_FRESHNESS determine the A003 bucket
PRODUCT_WORKSTREAM_DOMAIN.family_entry_traceability: a PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILIES entry is admissible as domain evidence only when the entry itself carries a traceable governed evidence reference (Amendment 001 PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILIES_rule); a family entry without a traceable source is not admissible
not_admissible_domain_evidence: the mere existence of the PRODUCT_ROOT_CAUSE_FAMILIES field
a family inferred from the case-id prefix

MEASUREMENT_WORKSTREAM_DOMAIN.DOMAIN_ELIGIBLE_when: governed case-specific Measurement evidence exists for the case
admissible_domain_evidence: explicit governed measurement diagnostic target or scope
NOT_admissible_domain_evidence: a uniform schema default for the measurement axis
an aggregate metric of any kind
MEASUREMENT_WORKSTREAM_DOMAIN.in_domain_but_unestablished: a domain-eligible case whose MEASUREMENT_STATUS is NOT_ESTABLISHED without historical-only measurement evidence remains in domain and projects to NOT_ESTABLISHED_CASES (A003 bucket 5); an out-of-domain case never does

CITATION_WORKSTREAM_DOMAIN.DOMAIN_ELIGIBLE_when: governed case-specific Citation evidence exists for the case
admissible_domain_evidence: explicit governed citation diagnostic target or scope
NOT_admissible_domain_evidence: citation safety invariants (invalid_citation_count = 0, citation_scope_violation = 0, F2 citation safety PASS)
CITATION_WORKSTREAM_DOMAIN.aggregate_metric_rule: citation_coverage = 0.4657 may create or support a QUALITY_GATE_LINK, but it must never create case domain membership and must never place all 42 cases into the WS-13 domain

NOT_ESTABLISHED_BUCKET_MEANING.admissible_content: only WORKSTREAM_DOMAIN_ELIGIBLE = YES cases whose primary-axis state cannot be classified into CURRENT_CONFIRMED / RESOLVED / CURRENT_NEGATIVE / HISTORICAL_OR_STALE
NOT_ESTABLISHED_BUCKET_MEANING.frozen_statement: NOT_ESTABLISHED means: workstream relevance is established, but the current state inside that workstream is not established. It does NOT mean: the case has no evidence relating it to this workstream.

DOMAIN_DENOMINATOR_RULE.inventory_partition: DOMAIN_ELIGIBLE_CASE_COUNT + OUT_OF_WORKSTREAM_DOMAIN_CASE_COUNT = 42 (the frozen case inventory count)
DOMAIN_DENOMINATOR_RULE.bucket_partition: CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CASES + HISTORICAL_OR_STALE_CASES + RESOLVED_CASES + CURRENT_NEGATIVE_CASES + NOT_ESTABLISHED_CASES = DOMAIN_ELIGIBLE_CASE_COUNT

NO_FORCED_GLOBAL_DENOMINATOR.condition: each membership must carry its own independent governed case-specific evidence
NO_FORCED_GLOBAL_DENOMINATOR.note: cross-workstream domain overlap is not duplicate counting; it follows from the accepted cross-axis independence

DOMAIN_EVIDENCE_TRACE.NO_CASE_SPECIFIC_WORKSTREAM_EVIDENCE_rol: the required reason code for DOMAIN_ELIGIBLE = NO (OUT_OF_WORKSTREAM_DOMAIN)
DOMAIN_EVIDENCE_TRACE.level_assignment_rule: DOMAIN_EVIDENCE_LEVEL is assigned from the governing source path under the frozen hierarchy S1 > S2 > S3 > S4

FROZEN_CASE_STATE_INPUT.note: this amendment freezes domain eligibility only; it derives no new case state and changes no axis value

R3_CONSISTENCY_GATES.DOMAIN_ELIGIBLE_CASE_WITHOUT_BUCKET: R3 must FAIL rather than silently drop the case
R3_CONSISTENCY_GATES.DOMAIN_MEMBERSHIP_WITHOUT_TRACE: R3 must FAIL rather than admit the membership

UNCHANGED_UNDER_THIS_AMENDMENT: A003 historical-only versus mechanically stale distinction
workstream_domain_eligibility.NOT_AUTHORIZATION_NOTE: domain eligibility is a review-scope rule only; it never creates readiness, priority, authorization or remediation content
